senses.gloss: f. collect. noun, or בִּינָתָא pl. (v. בֵּינָת) the inside part, whence the kernel of seeds.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 18b:6">B. Bath. 18ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אי בב׳</he> as to the grains (of mustard).
<cite ref="Gittin 69b:8">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>ניזדהר מב׳</he> let him guard against swallowing the seeds.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>בִּינֵי כמונא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="B00284"><he>בוני</he></cite>) cumin seeds.
